lines.en: Loose soil feels good to walk on.
I walk toward the glowing sculk.
Joints creak. I walk anyway.

lines.zh: 侵略者的腿，多长了一对。
lines.en: An aggressor grows one extra pair of legs.
Joints stiff, still good for ramming.
The rattle of bone is my footstep.

lines.zh: 前面那股活人气，是我的。
lines.en: That living scent ahead is mine.
There's always a living thing at the end of the road.
Whoever's ahead gets rammed.
I have one more layer of shell than the rest.
No living thing on the road. I walk anyway.
A step, a rattle, bones all the way.
Something important? Probably who to ram.
This husk is all echoes.
When I stand still, my bones rattle louder.
The rune is still in my claw.
Standing still itches worse than chasing.
In life I always guarded this crossing.
More cracks on my shell again.
Two layers of green coat my shell.
Two ribs broke. Still enough.
No need to breathe to charge.
We've met before, long ago.
You stand there like a post.
I'm not hungry — I just want a bite.

lines.zh: 幽匿螨的六足，你还认得吗。
lines.en: Do you still know these six sculk legs?
Something is moving behind you.
Don't run. I want the ram more than you want out.

lines.zh: 幽匿的光太暗，我靠嗅觉。
lines.en: Sculk light is dim — I go by smell.
What are you looking at? I strike first.

lines.zh: 把火把收起来，我讨厌光。
lines.en: Put that torch away. I hate light.

lines.zh: 他们叫我幽匿螨侵略者，记住。
lines.en: They call me Sculk Mite Aggressor. Remember.
Five drops of health - each one hurts.
Alive, I'd have wept at that.
Sculk grows in the crack.
My teeth are sculk fragments.

lines.zh: 我这钳子，是幽匿长出来的。
lines.en: These pincers grew out of the sculk.
A little numb — feels fine.
Ram me or stop dawdling.
A dent in my shell.
Pain - so I can still feel pain.

lines.zh: 这点幽匿壳，经不住一踩。
lines.en: This sculk shell will not survive a stomp.

lines.zh: 你手上那点光，晃得我挪不动。
lines.en: That light on your hand freezes me in place.
One bite, and I'll have the strength to ram.
Two points of armor — I can still ram it.
Drop the meat. You may go.
Rotten meat - I could gnaw it all night.
Give me something to grind my teeth on.

lines.zh: 腐味，跟我死前闻的一样。
lines.en: Rot; the same smell as before I died.
Put it down. I only want one bite.
My teeth are already clenched.
Stop shaking. The meat won't run.

lines.zh: 我这两点护甲，挡不住你的脚。
lines.en: Two armor won't stop your boot.

lines.zh: 我这点身子，撞了也不退。
lines.en: This small body does not back off.
You knocked my fangs crooked.
Steady - don't fall on me.
I am small, but I carry two layers of plate.
Bumping me? Good - saves me the charge.
My shoulder plate fell. Pick it up.
Bumped me? Then let's begin.

lines.zh: 骨头撞在幽匿上，响了一声。
lines.en: Bone hit sculk with a crack.
Why do the living run so fast?
Come closer. I won't bite you.
Don't look. There's a hole in my shell.
Hold hands? Take my fangs out first.
I remember the pattern on your shell.
Lean on me - my shell's still hard enough.
This body knows only ramming.

lines.zh: 我们挤在菌丝下面取暖。
lines.en: We huddle under the sculk threads.
Your bones are as cold as mine.
I want to hold you, but I'd break you.
Next life, I'll charge a little slower.

lines.zh: 这一小块菌，我藏了三回。
lines.en: I've hidden this little scrap three times.
Dug out of the soil, it goes to the nest.
This scrap of flesh is mine.
I'll hold it in my teeth where no one sees.
Hold it - don't drop it in a crack.

lines.zh: 侵略者的名字，我自己取的。
lines.en: I named myself aggressor.
I'll take it and eat when hungry.
No pockets on this shell - I'll carry it in my teeth.
I'll haul this sculk back to the nest.
This could smash a skull.
Right direction. Charge.
One step back from you, three forward from me.
Tonight there's something to ram.
One charge. That's all.
One good ram and it's over.
My whole brood has woken.

lines.zh: 我这一点血，全用来咬你。
lines.en: All my little health goes into biting you.
Hold still while I aim.
Those eyes are asking to be rammed.
Don't be scared. I hit true.
Caught your scent. Right here.

lines.zh: 我这只螨，比同类凶一点。
lines.en: This mite is a little meaner than its kin.
I can smell the sweat on you.
Don't look back. I'm already running.
The moment my eyes opened, they fixed on you.
Whoever blinks first dies.
This shell of mine is made for ramming.
Don't stop walking - I'm almost there.
You cannot run, I can smell you.
Sculk doesn't breathe. It spreads.

lines.zh: 站住，我的牙已经张开了。
lines.en: Hold still. My fangs are already bared.

lines.zh: 我是一窝里最凶的那只。
lines.en: I am the meanest of the brood.

lines.zh: 侵略者的爪子够到你了。
lines.en: The aggressor's claws reach you.
Blood trail, all the way.
This mite follows light; hiding is useless.
A charge needs no breath.

lines.zh: 地上全是幽匿，你踩得响。
lines.en: The ground is all sculk; you crunch loudly.
One ram isn't enough. Again.
Don't back away - I'll chase that too.
Wait - I haven't rammed enough.
I hear your bones shaking.
Don't circle. I don't turn.

lines.zh: 你越跑，我这副小身子越饿。
lines.en: The more you run, the hungrier this small body gets.
Two more marks on my shell now.

lines.zh: 侵略者的名号，不是白叫的。
lines.en: The name aggressor is not for nothing.
Two attack points, and I don't back off.
Turn around. I'm behind you.
Don't dodge. Face me.
Quiet. I'm not done ramming.
One isn't enough. Again.
Small as I am, I still bite.
Two hits is enough. I counted.
Your shell cracked. Nice sound.
That one landed solid.
Bone meets bone. Sound.
Sorry. I can't control it.

lines.zh: 这具身体只剩咬这一个用处。
lines.en: This body is good only for biting now.
Teeth on bone - that's the good part.
One hop and I'm at your throat.
I bite your ankle and hold.

lines.zh: 幽匿的气息，从我的牙缝里出来。
lines.en: Sculk breath comes from between my teeth.
Click! Bone against bone.
I rammed you - don't blame me.
Alive again, in this same shell.
My bones clicked once, and here I am.
Teeth first, legs after.
The soil under me is still that soft.
This body wakes up already charging.

lines.zh: 祭坛的石缝，我又爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the altar's cracks again.
First thing I see, I want to ram.

lines.zh: 幽匿的土一松，螨就爬出来。
lines.en: When the sculk soil loosens, mites crawl out.
Wherever the living are, I go.
Cold wind, rattling bones.

lines.zh: 刚从幽匿里爬出来，就咬。
lines.en: Fresh out of the sculk, and already biting.
The shell split open and I charged.
My shell is harder, and my teeth longer.

lines.zh: 土一松，幽匿螨就出来了。
lines.en: The soil loosens, and the sculk mite emerges.
Fire on my shell. Beat it out.
Fell and broke a leg. Still charging.
I don't breathe, yet water pours into my shell.
Even something my size feels a blast.
Stuck in my shell - free armor.
Magic burned through the shell.

lines.zh: 饿急了，我连幽匿块都啃。
lines.en: Starving, I gnaw even sculk blocks.
The lightning knocked me off the wall.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我这小身子散开了。
lines.en: In the void, my small body comes apart.
